objective: build a goal-conditioned multi-object pick-and-place task and reliable demonstration expert

expert.object_localization: requested-color segmentation plus calibrated RGB-D projection
expert.planning: analytical IK with retract-rotate-extend transport corridor

development_findings: slower direct transfer did not prevent long-radius object throws
a 0.20 m transport-radius corridor reduced lateral transfer load
grasping 0.012 m below the detected top surface stabilized transport
initial objects require 0.11 m separation for open-gripper clearance
object X below 0.23 m was outside the reliable close-in grasp envelope
decision: foundation accepted; proceed to goal-conditioned policy training with held-out combination evaluation
